title: General Grievous
franchise: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith
description: Trained in Lightsaber combat by Count Dooku, General Grievous was the cyborg leader of the Separatist armies during the Clone Wars. With his four arms each able to twirl a Lightsaber at alarming speeds, he was a capable killer of Jedi and feared for that skill. Known by his hacking cough, he was quick to run from a confrontation in order to fight another day, until General Kenobi arrived on Utapau...
